definitions.explanation: Bonds issued by national or local governments to finance public spending. Also refers to the resulting public debt.

examples.japanese: {公債|こうさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧。
{公債|こうさい}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The outstanding public debt has been increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公債|こうさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: The government had no choice but to issue a large volume of bonds to cover the fiscal deficit.

notes:
A compound of {公|こう} (public) and {債|さい} (debt, bond). Covers both national government bonds (⟦{国債|こくさい}→国債：12016_kokusai⟧) and local government bonds ({地方債|ちほうさい}).

Japan has one of the highest public debt-to-GDP ratios in the world, making {公債|こうさい} a frequently discussed topic in Japanese news and politics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公債|こうさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue government bonds
- {公債|こうさい}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: outstanding government debt
- {公債|こうさい}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: debt service costs
- {公債|こうさい}⟦{依存|いぞん}→依存：11441_izon⟧⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧: bond dependency ratio

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国債|こくさい}→国債：12016_kokusai⟧: national government bond — specifically bonds issued by the central government
- ⟦{社債|しゃさい}→社債：24079_shasai⟧: corporate bond — bonds issued by private companies
- {地方債|ちほうさい}: municipal bond — bonds issued by local governments
